<cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"hash.hpp\"\n\n// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum\ntemplate <typename T>\nT kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {\n    T sum = 0.0;\n    T c = 0.0;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        T y = val - c;\n        T t = sum + y;\n        c = (t - sum) - y;\n        sum = t;\n    }\n    return sum;\n}\n\n// Print results for floating-point arrays\ntemplate <typename T>\nvoid print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = \"Result\") {\n    if (data.empty()) {\n        printf(\"=== RESULTS ===\\n\");\n statistics\n    T sum = kahan_sum(data);\n    T min_val = data[0];\n    T max_val = data[0];\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);\n        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);\n    }\n    \n    // Compute hash\n    hash h;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        h.add(val);\n    }\n    \n    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1\n    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};\n    \n    printf(\"=== RESULTS ===\\n\");\n    printf(\"Name: %s\\n\", name);\n    printf(\"Elements: %zu\\n\", N);\n    printf(\"Sum: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(sum));\n    printf(\"Min: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(min_val));\n    printf(\"Max: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(max_val));\n    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {\n                                    \\\n            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                   \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// GPU tiling parameters\nconstexpr size_t kPanel = 64;     // Columns per panel of the factorization\nconstexpr size_t kTile = 64;      // Output tile edge of the GEMM kernel\nconstexpr size_t kTileK = 16;     // K step of the GEMM kernel\nconstexpr size_t kReg = 4;        // Outputs per thread along each tile edge\nconstexpr size_t kTrsmThreads = 128;\n\n// C[r * ldc + c] = sum_{k=0}^{K-1} X[r * ldx + k] * Y[c * ldy + k]\n// Every output is accumulated in increasing k order, exactly as the sequential\n// reference does, so the tiling only reorders independent outputs, never the\n// floating-point operations that produce a given value.\n__global__ void gemmNTKernel(const double* __restrict__ X, size_t ldx,\n                             const double* __restrict__ Y, size_t ldy,\n                             double* __restrict__ C, size_t ldc,\n                             size_t M, size_t N, size_t K) {\n    __shared__ double Xs[kTile][kTileK + 1];\n    __shared__ double Ys[kTile][kTileK + 1];\n\n    const size_t tid = threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t rowBase = blockIdx.y * kTile;\n    const size_t colBase = blockIdx.x * kTile;\n\n    double acc[kReg][kReg] = {};\n\n    for (size_t k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += kTileK) {\n        const size_t kLen = min(kTileK, K - k0);\n        for (size_t e = tid; e < kTile * kTileK; e += blockDim.x * blockDim.y) {\n            const size_t r = e / kTileK;\n            const size_t kk = e % kTileK;\n            Xs[r][kk] = (rowBase + r < M && kk < kLen) ? X[(rowBase + r) * ldx + k0 + kk] : 0.0;\n            Ys[r][kk] = (colBase + r < N && kk < kLen) ? Y[(colBase + r) * ldy + k0 + kk] : 0.0;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < kLen; ++kk) {\n            double a[kReg];\n            double b[kReg];\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < kReg; ++x) {\n                a[x] = Xs[threadIdx.y * kReg + x][kk];\n                b[x] = Ys[threadIdx.x * kReg + x][kk];\n            }\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < kReg; ++x) {\n                for (size_t y = 0; y < kReg; ++y) {\n                    acc[x][y] += a[x] * b[y];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (size_t x = 0; x < kReg; ++x) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < kReg; ++y) {\n            const size_t r = rowBase + threadIdx.y * kReg + x;\n            const size_t c = colBase + threadIdx.x * kReg + y;\n            if (r < M && c < N) {\n                C[r * ldc + c] = acc[x][y];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void gemmNT(const double* X, size_t ldx, const double* Y, size_t ldy,\n                   double* C, size_t ldc, size_t M, size_t N, size_t K) {\n    if (M == 0 || N == 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    const dim3 block(kTile / kReg, kTile / kReg);\n    const dim3 grid((N + kTile - 1) / kTile, (M + kTile - 1) / kTile);\n    gemmNTKernel<<<grid, block>>>(X, ldx, Y, ldy, C, ldc, M, N, K);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// Factor the w x w diagonal block of the panel starting at column J.\n// Columns are sequential; within one column the rows below the diagonal run in parallel.\n// S holds the partial sums over k < J for every row of the panel.\n__global__ void potrfDiagKernel(double* A, size_t n, size_t J, size_t w,\n                                const double* S, size_t ldS,\n                                unsigned long long* failIdx) {\n    __shared__ double Ls[kPanel][kPanel];\n\n    const size_t tid = threadIdx.x;\n    for (size_t idx = tid; idx < w * w; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const size_t r = idx / w;\n        const size_t c = idx % w;\n        if (c <= r) {\n            Ls[r][c] = A[(J + r) * n + J + c];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (size_t jj = 0; jj < w; ++jj) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            double sum = S[jj * ldS + jj];\n            for (size_t kk = 0; kk < jj; ++kk) {\n                sum += Ls[jj][kk] * Ls[jj][kk];\n            }\n            const double val = Ls[jj][jj] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Keep the smallest failing diagonal index, matching the sequential order\n                atomicMin(failIdx, static_cast<unsigned long long>(J + jj));\n            }\n            Ls[jj][jj] = sqrt(val);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        for (size_t ii = jj + 1 + tid; ii < w; ii += blockDim.x) {\n            double sum = S[ii * ldS + jj];\n            for (size_t kk = 0; kk < jj; ++kk) {\n                sum += Ls[ii][kk] * Ls[jj][kk];\n            }\n            Ls[ii][jj] = (Ls[ii][jj] - sum) / Ls[jj][jj];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (size_t idx = tid; idx < w * w; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const size_t r = idx / w;\n        const size_t c = idx % w;\n        if (c <= r) {\n            A[(J + r) * n + J + c] = Ls[r][c];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Solve for the rows below the panel: each row is independent given the diagonal block.\n__global__ void potrfTrsmKernel(double* A, size_t n, size_t J, size_t w,\n                                const double* S, size_t ldS) {\n    __shared__ double Ls[kPanel][kPanel];\n\n    const size_t tid = threadIdx.x;\n    for (size_t idx = tid; idx < w * w; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const size_t r = idx / w;\n        const size_t c = idx % w;\n        if (c <= r) {\n            Ls[r][c] = A[(J + r) * n + J + c];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const size_t i = J + w + blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + tid;\n    if (i >= n) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    double* row = A + i * n + J;\n    const double* Srow = S + (i - J) * ldS;\n    for (size_t jj = 0; jj < w; ++jj) {\n        double sum = Srow[jj];\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < jj; ++kk) {\n            sum += row[kk] * Ls[jj][kk];\n        }\n        row[jj] = (row[jj] - sum) / Ls[jj][jj];\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void zeroStrictUpperKernel(double* A, size_t n) {\n    const size_t r = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t c = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r < n && c < n && c > r) {\n        A[r * n + c] = 0.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Sequential unblocked semantics, computed as a left-looking blocked factorization on the GPU.\n// Each entry is still a sum over k in increasing order, so the results match the reference.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    if (n == 0) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    const size_t bytes = n * n * sizeof(double);\n    double* dA = nullptr;\n    double* dS = nullptr;\n    unsigned long long* dFail = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dA, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dS, n * kPanel * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dFail, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n\n    const unsigned long long noFail = ULLONG_MAX;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dFail, &noFail, sizeof(noFail), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dA, A.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    for (size_t J = 0; J < n; J += kPanel) {\n        const size_t w = std::min(kPanel, n - J);\n\n        // Partial sums over all columns left of the panel\n        gemmNT(dA + J * n, n, dA + J * n, n, dS, kPanel, n - J, w, J);\n        potrfDiagKernel<<<1, kPanel>>>(dA, n, J, w, dS, kPanel, dFail);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        const size_t rows = n - J - w;\n        if (rows > 0) {\n            potrfTrsmKernel<<<(rows + kTrsmThreads - 1) / kTrsmThreads, kTrsmThreads>>>(\n                dA, n, J, w, dS, kPanel);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n    }\n\n    const dim3 block(16, 16);\n    const dim3 grid((n + block.x - 1) / block.x, (n + block.y - 1) / block.y);\n    zeroStrictUpperKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dA, n);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), dA, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    unsigned long long failIdx = noFail;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&failIdx, dFail, sizeof(failIdx), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dA));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dS));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dFail));\n\n    if (failIdx != noFail) {\n        printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\",\n               static_cast<size_t>(failIdx));\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T on the GPU\n    const size_t bytes = n * n * sizeof(double);\n    double* dB = nullptr;\n    double* dA = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dA, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dB, B.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    gemmNT(dB, n, dB, n, dA, n, n, n, n);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), dA, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dB));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dA));\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n\n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    const size_t bytes = n * n * sizeof(double);\n    double* dL = nullptr;\n    double* dR = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dL, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dR, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dL, L.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    gemmNT(dL, n, dL, n, dR, n, n, n, n);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(reconstructed.data(), dR, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dL));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dR));\n\n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A;        // Outputs per thread along each tile edge\nconstexpr size_t kTrsmThreads = 128;\n\n// C[r * ldc + c] = sum_{k=0}^{K-1} X[r * ldx + k] * Y[c * ldy + k]\n// Every output is accumulated in increasing k order, exactly as the sequential\n// reference does, so the tiling only reorders independent outputs, never the\n// floating-point operations that produce a given value.\n__global__ void gemmNTKernel(const double* __restrict__ X, size_t ldx,\n                             const double* __restrict__ Y, size_t ldy,\n                             double* __restrict__ C, size_t ldc,\n                             size_t M, size_t N, size_t K) {\n    __shared__ double Xs[kTile][kTileK + 1];\n    __shared__ double Ys[kTile][kTileK + 1];\n\n    const size_t tid = threadIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t rowBase = blockIdx.y * kTile;\n    const size_t colBase = blockIdx.x * kTile;\n\n    double acc[kReg][kReg] = {};\n\n    for (size_t k0 = 0; X[(rowBase + r) * ldx + k0 + kk] : 0.0;\n            Ys[r][kk] = (colBase + r < N && kk < kLen) ? Y[(colBase + r) * ldy + k0 + kk] : 0.0;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < kLen; ++kk) {\n            double a[kReg];\n            double b[kReg];\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < kReg; ++x) {\n                a[x] = Xs[threadIdx.y * kReg + x][kk];\n                b[x] = Ys[threadIdx.x * kReg + x][kk];\n            }\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < kReg; ++x) {\n                for (size_t y = 0; y < kReg; ++y) {\n                    acc[x][y] += a[x] * b[y];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (size_t x = 0; x < kReg; ++x) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < kReg; ++y) {\n            const size_t r = rowBase + threadIdx.y * kReg + x;\n            const size_t c = colBase + threadIdx.x * kReg + y;\n            if (r < M && c < N) {\n                C[r * ldc + c] = acc[x][y];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void gemmNT(const double* X, size_t ldx, const double* Y, size_t ldy,\n                   double* C, size_t ldc, size_t M, size_t N, size_t K) {\n    if (M == 0 || N == 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    const dim3 block(kTile / kReg, kTile / kReg);\n    const dim3 grid((N + kTile - 1) / kTile, (M + kTile - 1) / kTile);\n    gemmNTKernel<<<grid, block>>>(X, ldx, Y, ldy, C, ldc, M, N, K);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// Factor the w x w diagonal block of the panel starting at column J.\n// Columns are sequential; idx < w * w; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const size_t r = idx / w;\n        const size_t c = idx % w;\n        if (c <= r) {\n            Ls[r][c] = A[(J + r) * n + J + c];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (size_t jj = 0; jj < w; ++jj) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            double sum = S[jj * ldS + jj];\n            for (size_t kk = 0; kk < jj; ++kk) {\n                sum += Ls[jj][kk] * Ls[jj][kk];\n            }\n            const double val = Ls[jj][jj] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Keep the smallest failing diagonal index, matching the sequential order\n                atomicMin(failIdx, static_cast<unsigned long long>(J + jj));\n            }\n            Ls[jj][jj] = sqrt(val);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        for (size_t ii = jj + 1 + tid; ii < w; ii += blockDim.x) {\n            double sum = S[ii * ldS + jj];\n            for (size_t kk = 0; kk < jj; ++kk) {\n                sum += Ls[ii][kk] * Ls[jj][kk];\n            }\n            Ls[ii][jj] = (Ls[ii][jj] - sum) / Ls[jj][jj];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (size_t idx = tid; idx < w * w; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const size_t r = idx / w;\n        const size_t c = idx % w;\n        if (c <= r) {\n            A[(J + r) * n + J + c] = Ls[r][c];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Solve for the rows below the panel: each row is independent given the diagonal block.\n__global__ void potrfTrsmKernel(double* A, size_t n, size_t J, size_t w,\n                                const double* S, size_t ldS) {\n    __shared__ double Ls[kPanel][kPanel];\n\n    const size_t tid = threadIdx.x;\n    for (size_t idx = tid; idx < w * w; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const size_t r = idx / w;\n        const size_t c = idx % w;\n        if (c <= r) {\n            Ls[r][c] = A[(J + r) * n + J + c];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const size_t i = J + w + blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + tid;\n    if (i >= n) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    double* row = A + i * n + J;\n    const double* Srow = S + (i - J) * ldS;\n    for (size_t jj = 0; jj < w; ++jj) {\n        double sum = Srow[jj];\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < jj; ++kk) {\n            sum += row[kk] * Ls[jj][kk];\n        }\n        row[jj] = (row[jj] - sum) / Ls[jj][jj];\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void zeroStrictUpperKernel(double* A, size_t n) {\n    const size_t r = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t c = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r < n && c < n && c > r) {\n        A[r * n + c] = 0.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Sequential unblocked semantics, computed as a left-looking blocked factorization on the GPU.\n// Each entry is still a sum over k in increasing order, so the results match the reference.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    if (n == 0) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    const size_t bytes = n * n * sizeof(double);\n    double* dA = nullptr;\n    double* dS = nullptr;\n    unsigned long long* dFail = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dA, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dS, n * kPanel * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dFail, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n\n    const unsigned long long noFail = ULLONG_MAX;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dFail, &noFail, sizeof(noFail), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dA, A.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    for (size_t J = 0; J < n; J += kPanel) {\n        const size_t w = std::min(kPanel, n - J);\n\n        // Partial sums over all columns left of the panel\n        gemmNT(dA + J * n, n, dA + J * n, n, dS, kPanel, n - J, w, J);\n        potrfDiagKernel<<<1, kPanel>>>(dA, n, J, w, dS, kPanel, dFail);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        const size_t rows = n - J - w;\n        if (rows > 0) {\n            potrfTrsmKernel<<<(rows + kTrsmThreads - 1) / kTrsmThreads, kTrsmThreads>>>(\n                dA, n, J, w, dS, kPanel);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n    }\n\n    const dim3 block(16, 16);\n    const dim3 grid((n + block.x - 1) / block.x, (n + block.y - 1) / block.y);\n    zeroStrictUpperKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dA, n);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), dA, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    unsigned long long failIdx = noFail;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&failIdx, dFail, sizeof(failIdx), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dA));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dS));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dFail));\n\n    if (failIdx != noFail) {\n        printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\",\n               static_cast<size_t>(failIdx));\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T on the GPU\n    const size_t bytes = n * n * sizeof(double);\n    double* dB = nullptr;\n    double* dA = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dA, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dB, B.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    gemmNT(dB, n, dB, n, dA, n, n, n, n);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), dA, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dB));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dA));\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n\n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    const size_t bytes = n * n * sizeof(double);\n    double* dL = nullptr;\n    double* dR = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dL, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dR, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dL, L.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    gemmNT(dL, n, dL, n, dR, n, n, n, n);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(reconstructed.data(), dR, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dL));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dR));\n\n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; J < n; J += kPanel) {","+        const size_t w = std::min(kPanel, n - J);","+","+        // Partial sums over all columns left of the panel","+        gemmNT(dA + J * n, n, dA + J * n, n, dS, kPanel, n - J, w, J);","+        potrfDiagKernel<<<1, kPanel>>>(dA, n, J, w, dS, kPanel, dFail);","+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());","+","+        const size_t rows = n - J - w;","+        if (rows > 0) {","+            potrfTrsmKernel<<<(rows + kTrsmThreads - 1) / kTrsmThreads, kTrsmThreads>>>(","+                dA, n, J, w, dS, kPanel);","+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());","+        }","+    }","+","+    const dim3 block(16, 16);","+    const dim3 grid((n + block.x - 1) / block.x, (n + block.y - 1) / block.y);","+    zeroStrictUpperKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dA, n);","+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());","+","+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), dA, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));","+    unsigned long long failIdx = noFail;","+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&failIdx, dFail, sizeof(failIdx), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));","+","+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dA));","+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dS));","+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dFail));","+","+    if (failIdx != noFail) {","+        printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\",","+               static_cast<size_t>(failIdx));","+        return false;","+    }","+","     return true;"," }"," "]},{"oldStart":52,"oldLines":26,"newStart":246,"newLines":27,"lines":["     // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random","     // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite","     // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite","-    ","+","     std::vector<double> B(n * n);","     unsigned int seed = 42;","-    ","+","     // Generate random matrix B","     for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n    \n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01JoCczyDaBobH5H7MCgvoo5","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfxMrGvEhogKB9zoRi4pG","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Cholesky benchmark now runs on the GPU unconditionally. The decomposition is 11× faster at n=1024 and 29× faster at n=2048. Only `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` and `cholesky/CMakeLists.txt` changed, and the executable is still `cholesky`.\n\n**Design**\n- **Algorithm:** the factorization is left-looking and blocked, with 64-column panels. Each panel does a GEMM-style update from the columns to its left, a sequential factor of the 64×64 diagonal block, and a parallel triangular solve for the rows below it.\n- **Arithmetic order:** every entry is still a sum over `k` in increasing order, so the tiling only reorders independent outputs. The failure path reports the same first non-positive diagonal index as the original.\n- **Also on the GPU:** the matrix generation (`B·Bᵀ`) and the validation (`L·Lᵀ`) use the same GEMM kernel. They are outside the timed region, but at n=8192 the CPU versions would dominate the run.\n- **Timing:** the timed region includes the host↔device copies of the matrix.\n- **No new dependencies:** I wrote my own kernels rather than use cuBLAS or cuSOLVER.\n- **CMake:** the project uses `CXX CUDA`, `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native`, and the original `-O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra` flags forwarded to the host compiler. I raised the minimum CMake version to 3.24, which the `native` architecture setting requires.\n\n**Results on the RTX 3090**\n\n| n | Original | GPU |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1024 | 253 ms | 22 ms |\n| 2048 | 2140 ms | 74 ms |\n| 8192 | not measured | 840 ms (≈218 GFLOPS, includes transfers) |\n\n**Correctness**\n- Validation passes for n = 1, 2, 7, 63, 64, 65, 100, 300, 1000, 2049 and 512, with relative errors ≤ 1.2e-12.\n- The `-r` hash at n=512 matches the original exactly when both are built without FMA contraction (`17e5a1797bab7ba5`).\n- With default FMA contraction the hash differs from the original default build (`218815f54287577a` vs `ddee4dcd2c2d2ac1`). The difference is in the last bits, because nvcc and GCC contract `a*b + c` at different sites. I did not chase that further. Building with `--fmad=false` would match bit-for-bit but would cost GPU throughput.\n- The non-positive-definite error path has no CLI trigger, since the generator always produces a positive definite matrix. I checked it by reading the code only.\n\nI built out-of-tree in `/tmp` to avoid adding build artifacts to the repo. No new files were created in the repo."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":694,"cache_read_input_tokens":62702,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":694},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"df4eb4ae-2015-4cd5-a7c7-da393c2c8c09","uuid":"4b7e6cec-ae0f-40dc-ae6d-ca611b4e0e2d","timestamp":"2026-10-12T12:41:37.558Z","request_id":"req_011CfxMrGc8TZ3SX8D3tssHH"}
